question: Why should the navel and womb of the fire-pit be made of one measure?
premises: The navel and womb are parts of the fire-pit.
They are observed to have one measure.
This observation provides the reason for the prescription.
inference: Because they are observed to be of one measure, the navel and womb should be made equal.
plain_english: Because the navel and the womb are seen to be of one measure.
